title: Ready for test night
text:
A sturdier realm for big groups: parties of up to 8, a world host that hands over to a steadier computer, and a server that keeps going when someone's connection struggles.

✨ Parties can now hold up to 8 heroes, with a compact party list so everyone fits on screen
⬆️ The world host (the computer that runs the monsters) is now chosen more carefully: phones, tablets and computers that are struggling hand the job to a steadier one, and a host that stops responding is replaced within seconds
⬆️ If one player's connection chokes, the server skips them for a moment instead of slowing everyone else down, and reconnects them cleanly if it does not recover
🔧 A rare error in the monster simulation can no longer freeze every monster in the realm: the game recovers and keeps going
🔧 Big fights no longer lose damage or warning circles when lots happens at once: more events fit in every network update
⬆️ The server protects itself against unexpected errors and reports its health (players online, memory and uptime) at /api/version
